gui.simplyscreens.screen.maintain_aspect: Preserve the image proportions instead of stretching it to fill the screen.
gui.simplyscreens.import.computer.help: Upload a PNG, JPG, or JPEG image to this server.
gui.simplyscreens.import.disabled: Image imports are disabled by the server
gui.simplyscreens.screen.upload.error.ty: Choose a PNG, JPG, or JPEG image.
gui.simplyscreens.screen.upload.error.re: The selected image could not be read.
gui.simplyscreens.screen.id.error.invali: Screen IDs may use letters, numbers, dots, underscores, colons, and hyphens.
gui.simplyscreens.remove.confirm.title: Remove image?
gui.simplyscreens.remove.confirm.body: "%s" will be removed from your server library.
gui.simplyscreens.status.selected: The selected image is now displayed.
gui.simplyscreens.access.title: Access
gui.simplyscreens.access.denied: Change failed. Refresh and check permissions, the player name or UUID, and the trusted-player limit.
gui.simplyscreens.access.help: Viewing and control permissions are separate from private image-library access.
gui.simplyscreens.access.policy_help: Operators have access in every mode. Owner only allows the owner; Operators only excludes non-OP owners. Owners can always manage access.
gui.simplyscreens.access.transfer_confir: Transfer ownership to %s? Your management access will be removed and the trusted list cleared.
gui.simplyscreens.access.player_help: Use an online player name or an offline player UUID.
gui.simplyscreens.access.transfer_help: Use an online player name or UUID. Transferring ownership may remove your management access.
gui.simplyscreens.access.invalid_player: Use an online player name or a complete UUID.
gui.simplyscreens.access.trusted_help: Trusted players receive access in Trusted mode. Only the owner and operators can manage access.
gui.simplyscreens.access.trust_limit: The trusted list is full (64 players).
gui.simplyscreens.access.override.help: On: this display uses its own image instead of the image shared by its Screen ID. Image changes here affect only this display. Off: follow the shared image again. Useful for screens linked with the same Screen ID.
gui.simplyscreens.access.claim.help: Operators can claim an unowned legacy display to manage its access settings.
gui.simplyscreens.access.view_label.help: Choose who can view images displayed by this screen. This does not grant access to the owner’s private image library. Operators have access in every mode. Operators only excludes non-OP owners; owners still manage access.
gui.simplyscreens.access.control_label.h: Choose who can change the displayed image. This does not grant ownership, access management, or access to another player’s private image library. Operators have access in every mode. Operators only excludes non-OP owners; owners still manage access.
gui.simplyscreens.access.remove.help: Remove this player from the trusted list. Their access through Trusted mode is revoked; Public access is unaffected.
gui.simplyscreens.screen.link.tooltip: Apply this Screen ID to share images and access settings with linked screens. You must manage both displays/networks. Clear the ID and apply to detach this display.
gui.simplyscreens.theme.tooltip: Switch between the light and dark interface themes.
gui.simplyscreens.personal.title: Your display settings
gui.simplyscreens.personal.scope: Only affects you, for all screens. Changes save automatically on this device.
gui.simplyscreens.personal.view_distance: Maximum distance in blocks at which screens are drawn for you. Larger values show screens farther away and can use more graphics resources. Does not change other players or server view permissions.
gui.simplyscreens.personal.save_failed: Could not save your display settings. Check that the config folder is writable.
gui.simplyscreens.playlist.edit_help: Editing saved slides does not change the running slideshow. Press Play to load your changes.
gui.simplyscreens.playlist.empty: No slides yet. Add images from the gallery.
gui.simplyscreens.playlist.no_playlists: Create a playlist, then add images from the gallery.
gui.simplyscreens.playlist.queue_help: Queued slides play once before the next saved slide. Saved playlists are unchanged.
gui.simplyscreens.playlist.name_help: Use a unique name, up to 64 characters.
gui.simplyscreens.playlist.invalid: Enter a valid name or duration.
gui.simplyscreens.playlist.delete_help: Delete “%s”? Its running snapshot will continue until stopped.
gui.simplyscreens.playlist.timeout: The slideshow did not respond. Refreshing; try again.
gui.simplyscreens.playlist.rejected: Playlist changed or permission was denied. Refreshed the latest state.
